hermesLib.rule.rankingEnabled.name: Ranking enabled
hermesLib.rule.rankingEnabled.desc: Master switch for all Hermes Lib data collection. When disabled no metric is collected at all.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackPlayTime.name: Track play time
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackPlayTime.desc: Collect how long each player (or fake player) has been online.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackBlocksMined.d: Collect how many blocks each player has broken.
Collect how many blocks each player has placed.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackMobKills.name: Track mob kills
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackMobKills.desc: Collect how many mobs each player has killed.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackPlayerKills.d: Collect how many players each player has killed.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackDeaths.name: Track deaths
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackDeaths.desc: Collect how many times each player has died.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackVillagerTrade: Collect how many villager trades each player has made.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackFishCaught.de: Collect how many times each player has reeled in a fishing hook.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackElytraDistanc: Collect the distance flown with an elytra, in centi-blocks.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackDamageDealt.d: Collect the amount of damage each player has dealt.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackDamageTaken.d: Collect the amount of damage each player has taken.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackMovement.name: Track movement
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackMovement.desc: Collect walking, sprinting, swimming, riding and elytra distance, in centi-blocks.
Collect the number of items produced by crafting.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackItemsPickedUp: Collect the number of items picked up from the ground.
Collect the number of items dropped on the ground.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackItemsUsed.des: Collect how many times each player has used an item.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackItemsBroken.d: Collect durability damage events and tools or armour that broke completely.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackAnimalsBred.d: Collect how many times each player has bred animals.
Collect how many animals each player has tamed.
Collect how many enchantments each player has applied.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackJumps.name: Track jumps
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackJumps.desc: Collect how many times each player has jumped.
hermesLib.rule.rankingMinedNaturalOnly.n: Only count natural blocks as mined
hermesLib.rule.rankingMinedNaturalOnly.d: Only count blocks that were not placed by a player. Prevents place-then-mine farming.
hermesLib.rule.rankingSeparateFakePlayer: Store fake player data in the FAKE domain instead of REAL. When disabled fake data still keeps its own UUID, so real player data is never overwritten.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackSurvival.name: Track survival mode players
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackSurvival.desc: Whether to track players in survival mode (real players and fake players alike). When disabled, players in this mode produce no stats at all.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackAdventure.des: Whether to track players in adventure mode (real players and fake players alike). When disabled, players in this mode produce no stats at all.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackSpectator.des: Whether to track players in spectator mode (real players and fake players alike). When disabled, players in this mode produce no stats at all.
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackCreative.name: Track creative mode players
hermesLib.rule.rankingTrackCreative.desc: Whether to track players in creative mode (real players and fake players alike). When disabled, players in this mode produce no stats at all.
